name: Count
intent: Small number badge for counts, like unread items on a nav link or tab.
usage: Use Count for a number next to a nav item, tab, button or icon, like 3 unread. Use Badge for words. Counts above max show as max+ (99+). Pass label so screen readers hear 3 unread messages, not just 3. See contracts/count.json for the full contract.

tone.note: danger for items that need action now. neutral for plain totals.

size.note: Heights 16 / 20 / 24. sm and md are the standard counts; lg is for larger controls.

subtle.note: Lighter fill. Defined for info, neutral and danger.

max.note: Above max the Count shows max+.

label.note: What is counted, for screen readers, like unread messages.

useWhen: Unread or pending counts on nav items, tabs and buttons.
A total next to a section title.
doNot: Do not invent a local counter or notification dot.
Do not put words in a Count. Use Badge.
Do not use Count as a button.
Do not show more than one danger Count in a row.
a11y: The visible number is hidden from screen readers; they hear the full count plus label instead, like 150 unread messages.
Tone is never the only signal; the number carries the meaning.

examples.title: Tones
examples.usage: info is the default. danger for items that need action now. neutral for plain totals.

examples.title: Subtle
examples.usage: Lighter fill for quieter counts, like totals in a list.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.usage: sm 16px and md 20px are the standard counts; lg 24px is for larger controls. The width grows with the number.

examples.title: Max
examples.usage: Counts above max show max+. The default max is 99.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.usage: Gray with faint text, for counts on a disabled item.
